narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>In the second one, minus twelve y plus seven y is five y.
<bookmark mark='line'/>Go back twelve steps, then forward seven. You end five steps below zero.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The minus sign stays, so that join must be minus five y.

<bookmark mark='c2'/>The brackets give minus one times five, which is minus five. The answer also gives minus five.
<bookmark mark='c3'/>In the second, take y as zero and z as one. Both sides give fifty six.
